{{Quote|Exonium's no hollinium, but it's worth a few credits.|An exonium prospector|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Hollinium''' was a valuable and extremely heavy [[Flight/Legends|elemental]] metal<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was used in the creation of synthetic [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbarides]]; it was considerably more valuable than [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]]. It had a compound, [[hollinium chloride]], that formed on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. One hundred grams of hollinium [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] was used by [[Urias Xhaxin]] to buy the ''[[Free Lance]]''.<ref name="Pirates & Privateers">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
